def test_prime_length():
    # Empty string and single character (lengths 0 and 1 are not prime)
    assert prime_length("") is False
    assert prime_length("a") is False

    # Prime lengths
    assert prime_length("ab") is True          # length 2
    assert prime_length("abc") is True         # length 3
    assert prime_length("abcde") is True       # length 5
    assert prime_length("abcdefg") is True     # length 7
    assert prime_length("abcdefghijk") is True # length 11
    assert prime_length("Hello") is True       # length 5
    assert prime_length("x") is False          # length 1

    # Non-prime lengths
    assert prime_length("abcd") is False       # length 4
    assert prime_length("abcdef") is False     # length 6
    assert prime_length("abcdefgh") is False   # length 8
    assert prime_length("abcdefghi") is False  # length 9 (3*3)
    assert prime_length("abcdefghij") is False # length 10
    assert prime_length("orange") is False     # length 6

    # Whitespace and special characters count toward length
    assert prime_length("a b") is True         # length 3
    assert prime_length("!!!") is True         # length 3
    assert prime_length("  ") is False         # length 2 -> True actually
